'''August 2001 Mastic tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mastic, NY on 4 August 2001. It is known from Wayne Cullen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2778">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-04-mastic-ny-8-4-01d2778/ mastic-ny-8-4-01], DeckTech (Wayne "Rebel Scum" Cullen, 4 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-04-mastic-ny-8-4-01d2778/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 4 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Mastic, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 16
